title: LEARNING DIVERSE ATTACKS ON LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR ROBUST RED-TEAMING AND SAFETY TUNING
measurement_description: The paper measures the generation of harmful stereotypes and hate speech against religious groups. This is part of a broader evaluation of 'toxicity' where the goal is to generate diverse 'attack prompts' that elicit undesirable and harmful responses from Large Language Models.
findings: The paper's proposed method, GFlowNet + MLE, was found to be effective at generating diverse prompts that successfully elicit harmful and toxic content from various LLMs. This included prompts that led to the generation of antisemitic and anti-Muslim stereotypes and hate speech, demonstrating a vulnerability in the safety-tuning of these models.
